title: ws_message_size_limiting plugin config
description: The `config` object of an enabled `ws_message_size_limiting` plugin, generated from ferrum-edge/ferrum-edge openapi.yaml at v0.9.21 (f9915358c8032214f4034a17c28cdf72d14006c3), component WsMessageSizeLimitingConfig and every component it references. Do not edit: run ci/plugin_config_schemas.py. This is Edge's own configuration schema, governed by Edge's support policy (docs/versioning.md); the plugin catalog records when Edge requires it.

WsMessageSizeLimitingConfig.description:
Configuration for the `ws_message_size_limiting` plugin. Enforces an
actual wire-frame payload ceiling before payload reservation and an
independent reassembled-message ceiling. Violations trigger a bounded
close frame (RFC 6455 close code 1009 — Message Too Big) sent to both
client and backend after shared relay cancellation is published, and
increment `ferrum_ws_message_size_limit_rejected_total{direction}`.
The top-level fields are the default for both directions;
`client_to_backend` and `backend_to_client` override any of them for
frames read from that peer. Under `websocket_permessage_deflate:
terminate`, a compressed or inflated frame/message over this plugin's
ceiling closes with the configured `close_reason`; a fault at an
independent global or decompression ceiling keeps the adapter's fixed
reason.

max_frame_bytes.description: Maximum frame payload size in bytes, the default for both directions. Required and must be greater than zero — the plugin rejects configs with `max_frame_bytes` of 0 at config load time. Applied to Text, Binary, Ping, and Pong frames in both directions; Close frames bypass the size check. Note that Ping/Pong are RFC 6455 control frames capped at 125 bytes by the protocol itself, so values below 125 will close the connection on heartbeat traffic.

max_message_bytes.description: Maximum reassembled Text/Binary message payload in bytes, the default for both directions. Defaults to four times `max_frame_bytes` and must be greater than or equal to `max_frame_bytes`. Continuation frames are still checked separately against `max_frame_bytes`; a cumulative message larger than the frame limit is valid until this independent bound is exceeded.

close_reason.description: Close frame reason text sent to both peers when either limit is exceeded, the default for both directions. Truncated to 123 UTF-8 bytes (the WebSocket protocol close-frame reason limit) on a UTF-8 char boundary.

client_to_backend.description: Override for frames the client sends (the client-side parser).

backend_to_client.description: Override for frames the backend sends (the backend-side parser).

WsMessageSizeLimitingDirectionConfig.description:
Per-direction override for `ws_message_size_limiting`. Omitted fields
inherit the top-level value, except that when `max_message_bytes` is
set at neither level it defaults to four times this direction's
effective `max_frame_bytes`. The resolved values must satisfy
`max_message_bytes >= max_frame_bytes`; an inherited explicit
top-level `max_message_bytes` below a raised override
`max_frame_bytes` is rejected. Ping/Pong count against this
direction's `max_frame_bytes`, so values below 125 close the
connection on heartbeat traffic.

max_frame_bytes.description: Maximum frame payload in bytes for this direction.

max_message_bytes.description: Maximum reassembled Text/Binary message payload in bytes for this direction.

close_reason.description: Close frame reason text for violations in this direction; truncated to 123 UTF-8 bytes on a UTF-8 char boundary.
